business_summary: Succeed co.,ltd. provides human resource services for education and welfare industries in Japan. It operates through Educational Personnel Support Business; Welfare Personnel Support Business; Individual Tutoring Classroom Business; Private Tutoring Business; Unico Business; and Others segments. The company offers personal introduction and dispatches personnel to cram schools and educational institutions, as well as to nurseries, kindergartens, after-school care facilities, and nursing care facilities; and operates Individual Tutoring Academy Succeed and Pentas Kids. It also provides private tutoring services to individuals; child development support services and after-school day care services; and private tutoring service placement services. In addition, the company provides dispatch ICT support staff to support the promotion of educational DX, including the GIGA School Initiative; human resource support services, such as classroom managers, instructors, and teachers for tutoring centers, gymnastics schools, and other extracurricular activity schools; club activity instructor; contract management of on-campus tutoring services; and human resource support for daycare centers and after-school program. Succeed co.,ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.
